verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote-desktop product, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a CLI, a REST API with an open-source Python module, and an llms.txt docs file. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an official MCP server, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
